title: Design System: Systems Programming Study Guide

cover-sienna.note: Cover board for home and glossary; also the cover's part ink. Dark: #6a2d15 board, #e9a585 ink.

oxide-orange.note: Part I board (Memory in C++). Dark: #9c3a15.

oxide-orange-ink.note: Part I ink on the leaf. Dark: #f19a73.

chrome-yellow.note: Part II board (Concurrency in Java); print on it is print-ink. Dark: #d29e00.

chrome-yellow-ink.note: Part II ink on the leaf. Dark: #f2c94c.

board-teal-ink.note: Part III ink on the leaf. Dark: #6fc9cf.

ultramarine.note: Part IV board and ink (Databases). Dark: #2a3c9e board, #9fabff ink.

review-violet-ink.note: Part V ink on the leaf. Dark: #c4a6f5.

on-board-light.note: Print on every board except chrome yellow.

milk-leaf.note: Base of the leaf; canonical value is color-mix(in oklab, var(--board) 3%, #f7f7f2). Dark: color-mix(in oklab, var(--board) 6%, #1b1c1f).

print-ink.note: Text, filled marks, pressed buttons. Dark: #ebebe6.

field.note: Hover fills, inline code; canonical color-mix(in oklab, var(--board) 5%, #eeeee7). Dark: 10% into #26272c.

headline.purpose: Chapter and glossary titles beside the chapter number.

title.purpose: Section heads in a chapter (h2); h3 1.22rem/700, h4 1.02rem/700.

body.purpose: Running prose, max 44rem column; 1.25rem/1.6 on phone.

lead.purpose: Summary under a page title, muted.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked furniture labels: rail part label, table heads, code language, search-result part.

tab-label.purpose: Condensed caps on fore-edge tabs, vertical on desktop.

code.purpose: Code panels and blanks; inline code at 0.84em.

shadows.name: leaf
shadows.purpose: The reading leaf on its board; dark: 0 1px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3), 0 18px 40px -18px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.7).

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Search results, section-turn popovers, continue slab; dark: 0 8px 18px -10px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6).

shadows.name: tab
shadows.purpose: Divider tab tucked under the leaf edge.

shadows.name: tab-current
shadows.purpose: The open part's tab, which is the leaf pulled out.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default for every UI transition and keyframe.

motion.name: turn
motion.value: 200ms; from opacity 0, perspective(1600px) rotateY(-2.5deg) translateX(-6px); origin left center
motion.purpose: Route and section change: the leaf hinges from its punched edge.

motion.name: enter
motion.value: 200ms; from opacity 0, translateY(6px); chapter list staggered 20ms, capped at 5
motion.purpose: Revealed hints/solutions, opened folds, home chapter rows.

motion.name: pop
motion.purpose: Search results, section-turn popovers, check results, solved flag.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Active state on buttons, continue, hops, section turns.

motion.name: tab-lift
motion.purpose: Fore-edge tab hover on fine pointers.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Keep fades that explain a change, drop all movement.

breakpoints.name: phone-narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Only the current tab keeps its name.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Header bar, horizontal tab strip, full-width leaf, no punch.

breakpoints.name: margin-turns
breakpoints.purpose: Section turns hang in the outer margin at and above this width.

extensions.darkMode: prefers-color-scheme: dark darkens each board one step, lightens each part ink, and moves the leaf to #1b1c1f (6% board tint) with #ebebe6 ink; values recorded per token in colorMeta notes.

narrative.overview:
The guide is a physical reference manual. Each of the course's parts is a coloured divider board that fills the window; each chapter is a milk reading leaf laid on its part's board, punched with holes down its bound edge so the board shows through. Down the fore edge, one tab per part steps the length of the course: each tab is as tall as its part has chapters, and the open part's tab is the leaf itself pulled out into the board. The reader always knows which part they are in (the board colour) and how far the course runs (the tabs).

The leaf is calm: near-black print ink on milk, hairline rules, a serif reading column of about 68 characters, Archivo for heads and labels. Colour lives on the boards and in a single part ink on the leaf; everything else is ink, hairline and paper. State is a printed mark, never a new hue: an open box for an unsolved exercise, a filled box when solved, a punched hole in board colour for the current place.

Motion is a page being handled: a section or chapter turn hinges the leaf from its punched edge, tabs slide a few pixels out of the fore edge on hover, popovers pop from 97%. Nothing ambient, nothing over 300ms in UI, and reduced motion keeps only the fades.
keyCharacteristics: One board colour per part, set by the page's `data-part` and inherited by the whole manual.
A milk leaf with a punched bound edge on a full-bleed board.
Fore-edge tabs stepped by part length; the current tab is the leaf.
Serif reading, wide-axis Archivo heads, condensed caps only on tabs.
State as marks in ink: open box, filled box, punched hole.
Short ease-out motion; transform and opacity only.

rules.name: The One Board Rule
rules.body: A page shows exactly one board: the part it belongs to. Other parts' hues appear only as their own tabs and numerals, never as accents on the leaf.

rules.name: The Mark Not Hue Rule
rules.body: Progress and correctness are shown as ink marks (open box, filled box, struck box, filled hole), never as green/red fills. Danger tints only the trap callout.

rules.name: The Readable Ink Rule
rules.body: Board hues never carry text on the leaf; use the part ink (the darkened pair) for any coloured text on milk.

rules.name: The Serif Reads, The Grotesque Labels Rule
rules.body: Running prose is always Source Serif 4; Archivo is for headings, navigation, controls and labels.

rules.name: The Lead-In Rule
rules.body: A content block names its kind with a sentence-case Archivo lead-in ("Watch for this", "Proof", "Solution") or as a part-ink word inside its heading ("Example · An array on the heap"); never as a tracked-caps eyebrow above a heading.

rules.name: The Flat Leaf Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the leaf casts a shadow at rest; cards and code are separated by hairline or ground, and only floating overlays use Lift.

dos: **Do** set the board by the page's part (`data-part`) and let every board-coloured element inherit it.
**Do** size each fore-edge tab by the number of chapters in its part.
**Do** show state with ink marks: open box, filled box, struck box, punched hole in board colour.
**Do** keep the reading column at 44rem max in Source Serif 4, 1.125rem/1.65.
**Do** use the part ink, not the board hue, for coloured text on the leaf.
**Do** animate only transform and opacity, ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)), 150-240ms; keep only fades under reduced motion.
**Do** gate hover movement behind `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`.
donts: **Don't** put a second part's hue on a page's leaf, or add a brand accent outside the divider wheel.
**Don't** colour correctness green or red; danger is reserved for the trap callout.
**Don't** place tracked-caps eyebrows or kickers above titles; block kinds are sentence-case lead-ins or part-ink words in the heading.
**Don't** give cards, code or figures a shadow on the leaf.
**Don't** round beyond 6px; the only circles are punched holes.
**Don't** add ambient or looping motion, or UI transitions over 300ms.
